description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified job, which is typically used to update the job
description_zh: 获取指定Jobid任务详情，通常用来更新任务
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 get-job-info --job-id 92583 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobInfo

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID on the Job Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The namespace source. This parameter is required only for specific third-party integrations
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

Data.description_en: The information about the specified job

AttemptInterval.description_en: The retry interval for errors, in seconds. Default value: 30
AttemptInterval.description_zh: 错误重试间隔时间，单位s，默认值为30

ClassName.description_en: The full path of the job interface class. This field is available only for Java jobs
ClassName.description_zh: 任务接口类完整路径，仅是Java类型任务时有该字段

ExecuteMode.description_en:
The job execution mode. Valid values:

standalone: Standalone execution.
broadcatst: Broadcast execution.
parallel: Parallel computing.
grid: In-memory grid.
batch: Grid computing.
shard: Sharding execution
ExecuteMode.description_zh:
任务执行模式，目前包含以下几种任务执行模式：

单机运行：standalone
广播运行：broadcatst
并行计算：parallel
内存网格：grid
网格计算：batch
分片运行：shard

JarUrl.description_en:
The full path of the JAR package uploaded to OSS.

If you select the JAR package execution mode, you can upload the JAR package to this path in OSS
JarUrl.description_zh:
上传到OSS的完整路径。

如果选择JAR包运行，可以将相应JAR包上传到OSS的该路径下

UserMail.description_en: The email address of the user

UserPhone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the user

MonitorConfig.description_en: The alert switch and threshold configurations
MonitorConfig.description_zh: 报警开关以及阈值配置

FailEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable failure alerts. Valid values:

true: Enables failure alerts.
false: Disables failure alerts
FailEnable.description_zh:
失败报警开关。取值如下：

true：开启失败报警开关。
false：关闭失败报警开关

MissWorkerEnable.description_en: Specifies whether to enable alerts for unavailable workers
MissWorkerEnable.description_zh: 是否开启无可用机器报警

SendChannel.description_en: The alert notification method. Currently, only SMS is supported
SendChannel.description_zh: 报警发送形式，目前只支持sms

Timeout.description_en: The timeout threshold, in seconds. Default value: 7200
Timeout.description_zh: 超时阈值，单位为秒（s），默认值为7200

TimeoutEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable timeout alerts. Valid values:

true: Enables timeout alerts.
false: Disables timeout alerts
TimeoutEnable.description_zh:
超时报警开关。取值如下：

true：开启超时报警开关。
false：关闭超时报警开关

TimeoutKillEnable.description_en: Specifies whether to terminate the current execution upon timeout. By default, this feature is disabled
TimeoutKillEnable.description_zh: 超时终止本次触发开关，默认关闭

MapTaskXAttrs.description_en: The advanced configurations. These configurations apply only to parallel computing, in-memory grid, and grid computing modes
MapTaskXAttrs.description_zh: 高级配置，仅限于并行计算、内存网格和网格计算使用

ConsumerSize.description_en: The number of execution threads triggered per machine at a time. Default value: 5
ConsumerSize.description_zh: 单机单次触发执行线程数，默认值为5

DispatcherSize.description_en: The number of threads for distributing subtasks. Default value: 5
DispatcherSize.description_zh: 子任务分发线程数，默认值为5

PageSize.description_en: The number of subtasks pulled at a time for a parallel job. Default value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 并行任务单次拉取子任务数，默认值为100

QueueSize.description_en: The maximum cache size of the subtask queue. Default value: 10000
QueueSize.description_zh: 子任务队列缓存上限，默认值为10000

TaskAttemptInterval.description_en: The retry interval for failed subtasks

TaskMaxAttempt.description_en: The maximum number of retries for failed subtasks

MaxAttempt.description_en: The maximum number of retries for errors. Set this value based on your business requirements. Default value: 0
MaxAttempt.description_zh: 错误最大重试次数，根据业务需求填写，默认值为0

MaxConcurrency.description_en: The maximum number of concurrently running instances. Default value: 1. A value of 1 indicates that if the previous trigger has not finished running, the next trigger will not be executed even if the scheduled time is reached
MaxConcurrency.description_zh: 最大同时运行实例数量，默认值为1， 即上次触发没有运行结束，即使到了运行时刻也不会进行下次触发

Parameters.description_en: The custom parameters defined by the user, which can be obtained during runtime
Parameters.description_zh: 用户自定义参数，运行时可以获取

Status.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

1: Enabled. The job can be triggered normally.
0: Disabled. The job cannot be triggered
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值如下：

1：启用，可以被正常触发。
0：禁用，不会被触发

Calendar.description_en: The custom calendar. This parameter is available when the time type is set to cron
Calendar.description_zh: cron类型可以选择填写自定义日历

DataOffset.description_en: The time offset, in seconds. This parameter is available when the time type is set to cron
DataOffset.description_zh: cron类型可以选择时间偏移，单位为秒（s）

TimeExpression.description_en:
The time expression. Valid values:

api: No time expression.
fix_rate: A specific fixed frequency value. For example, 30 indicates that the job is triggered once every 30 seconds.
cron: A standard cron expression.
second_delay: A fixed delay in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60
TimeExpression.description_zh:
时间表达式，目前支持以下几种时间表达类型：

api：无时间表达式。
fix_rate：具体固定频率值，如30表示每隔30s触发一次。
cron：标准的cron表达式。
second_delay：固定延迟多少秒执行一次（1s~60s可选）

TimeType.description_en:
The time configuration type. Valid values:

1: cron
3: fix_rate
4: second_delay
5: one_time
100: api
TimeType.description_zh:
时间配置类型，目前支持以下几种时间类型：

cron：1
fix_rate：3
second_delay：4
one_time ：5
api：100

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，仅错误时返回错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the job details were retrieved. Valid values:

true: The job details were retrieved.
false: The job details failed to be retrieved
Success.description_zh:
获取任务详情是否成功。取值如下：

true：获取任务详情成功。
false：获取任务详情失败
